card.name: Inside tera, peta and giga units
card.fires_on: Pieces of large SI unit words such as tera-, peta- and giga- (terawatts, petaflops, terabytes, gigahertz), right after a number. Also the q in MBq.

modes.label: Tera/peta/giga prefix
modes.description: The prefix or its inner piece in a large-scale unit word after a number.
modes.example: producing a hundred<< ter>>abytes of data

modes.label: Later piece of the unit
modes.description: A middle piece of a split unit word such as petaflops or terawatts.

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted tokens are unrelated to the unit-word completions.
card.plain: It fires inside big-number measurement words like terabytes, gigawatts and petaflops.
